concept.reason: Actual published specimen photo plus original lateral/top/front cranial drawings and foot description suffice.

scope: Complete small gracile horn-bearing male ungulate with multiple cranial appendages. Do not reduce to skull or use Synthetoceras Y horn.

scale.basis: Osborn/Wortman1892p356 male skull occipital condyle to premaxillary tip215mm, facial region130mm. Different specimens:2021 femaleAMNH1229 measured20.75cm; maleAMNH53523 incomplete18.8cm NOT full length.
scale.whole_size_status: Illustrative small gracile sheep-sized body reconstruction, not directly measured articulated skeleton.

diagnostic_targets: Complete long-legged light-bodied ungulate, long narrow face approximately60-67percent skull length.
Paired maxillary plates rise on sides of elongated rostrum, with separate roots and flattened inward-curving profiles; NOT one central bifurcated nasal shaft.

Paired low supraorbital flares above lateral eyes plus separate more posterior parietal projections. Three major bilateral regions; small accessory bumps may be simplified but do not replace plates with6generic cones.
Maxillary plates and parietal projections rise distinctly, supraorbital forms flare sideways. Horn/plate count and placement visible in top/front views, not confluent ears.
Small upper canines directed downward, not elephant tusks; narrow herbivore muzzle, lateral eyes and separate ears.

Forefeet retain four slender toes with substantial lateral toes slightly shorter than central pair. Hindfeet have two dominant elongated toes with rudimentary lateral toes; do not make all four feet identical modern deer hooves.
Elongated slender limbs with connected joints, compact trunk, modest neck, short understated tail; no long giraffe neck.
uncertainties: 2021 study identifies males by cranial ornamentation and separates female and crushed incomplete male measurements. Do not extrapolate exact full body dimensions from damaged male.
1892 appendage illustrations are original specimen drawings, soft tissue coverage is not directly preserved. Use understated skin-covered shapes without invented horn rings.
Whole-body lengths, tail, ears and coat are conservative reconstruction choices. No copy of other species body mesh or artwork.
Historical paper used Lower Miocene dating; use current Oligocene context from later study rather than historical date terminology.
acceptance_checklist: Paired rostral plates, supraorbital flares, posterior parietal projections distinguish from recentSynthetoceras.
Anterior-Y +Zup, exactGLB fourviews only, readable lateral/front/top silhouette.
Selfcontained dependencies, two deterministic rebuilds, separate independent review.
surface_profile: Palette-only, opaque single-sided Principled materials; original deliberate faceted lofts; no textures, external geometry, rig, or animation.

presentation.view_conventions: Front -Y, side +X, top +Z, perspective +X/-Y/+Z octant. Neutral warm background; no exported floor.
